details.eligibility: Graduation (Bachelor's degree) from a recognised university. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: CBT 1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. CBT 2: 120 questions. Negative marking 1/3 per wrong answer. Then Typing Skill Test / CBAT for applicable posts, Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness (CBT 1 and CBT 2).
details.important_dates: CEN 06/2024: CBT 1 held 5-24 Jun 2025; CBT 2 held 13 Oct 2025.

No official paper PDF could be verified from this VM on 2026-11-21: curl to rrbapply.gov.in and rrbcdg.gov.in returned 000 (unreachable) and the fetch attempt errored, so no official link is claimed here. Use the official portal for answer keys/notifications. The six cdn.testbook.com PDFs are unofficial compilations from the official answer key, NOT RRB-published papers. Testbook amp page returned HTTP 500 via curl (bot protection); the non-amp page returned 200 and is used here.
